# Security policy

## Supported versions

There is no release yet.
Security fixes go to the `main` branch.

## Report a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue or pull request for a vulnerability.
Send the report by email to [vexzyl@pm.me](mailto:vexzyl@pm.me).
Include the commit, the steps to reproduce, and the effect.
GitHub private vulnerability reporting will be used for this repository once it is enabled.

The original Codex app and the `codex` CLI and app-server are OpenAI projects.
Report a vulnerability in them to OpenAI, as the [Codex security policy](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/main/SECURITY.md) tells.
